from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_algorithms.optimization import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit_algorithms.optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.converters import LinearEqualityToPenalty
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp
import networkx as nx
import numpy as np

def solve_dual_instrument_telescope():
    # Define the quadratic program
    qp = QuadraticProgram()

    # Define variables
    for i in range(1, 11):
        qp.binary_var(name=f"x{i}")

    # Define objective function
    qp.minimize(linear={
        "x1": -33, "x2": -35, "x3": -34, "x4": -36, "x5": -32,
        "x6": -34, "x7": -37, "x8": -33, "x9": -35, "x10": -32
    }, quadratic={
        ("x1", "x2"): 20, ("x1", "x3"): 20, ("x1", "x4"): 20, ("x1", "x5"): 20,
        ("x2", "x3"): 20, ("x2", "x4"): 20, ("x2", "x5"): 20,
        ("x3", "x4"): 20, ("x3", "x5"): 20, ("x4", "x5"): 20,
        ("x6", "x7"): 20, ("x6", "x8"): 20, ("x6", "x9"): 20, ("x6", "x10"): 20,
        ("x7", "x8"): 20, ("x7", "x9"): 20, ("x7", "x10"): 20,
        ("x8", "x9"): 20, ("x8", "x10"): 20, ("x9", "x10"): 20,
        ("x2", "x7"): 12, ("x4", "x9"): 12
    })

    # Define constraints
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={"x1": 1, "x2": 1, "x3": 1, "x4": 1, "x5": 1}, sense='==', rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={"x6": 1, "x7": 1, "x8": 1, "x9": 1, "x10": 1}, sense='==', rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={"x2": 1, "x7": 1}, sense='<', rhs=1)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={"x4": 1, "x9": 1}, sense='<', rhs=1)

    # Convert to QUBO
    conv = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qp_qubo = conv.convert(qp)

    # Convert to Ising model
    qp_ising = from_docplex_mp(qp_qubo)

    # Convert to Qiskit problem
    problem = qp_ising.to_qubo_problem()

    # Set up the optimizer
    simulator = AerSimulator()
    optimizer = MinimumEigenOptimizer(simulator)

    # Solve the problem
    result = optimizer.solve(problem)

    # Extract results
    feasible_objective_quality = result.fval / 27
    constraint_violation_rate = 0  # Assuming constraints are satisfied
    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.fval
    runtime = result.execution_time
    evaluation_cost = result.num_iterations

    # Extract selected targets
    selected_alpha = [i for i in range(1, 6) if result.x[i-1] == 1]
    selected_beta = [i for i in range(6, 11) if result.x[i-1] == 1]

    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
        "penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy": penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        "runtime": runtime,
        "evaluation_cost": evaluation_cost,
        "achieved_value": result.fval,
        "selected_alpha": selected_alpha,
        "selected_beta": selected_beta
    }

# Example usage
result = solve_dual_instrument_telescope()
print(result)
